crossRefs.note: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
“Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?”…
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

translations.web: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
translations.bsb: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
translations.kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
translations.asv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;
